hints.title: Monotonic Row Property
hints.text: Because each row is sorted non-decreasingly, all zeros precede all ones in every row.

hints.title: Top Right Staircase Traversal
hints.text: Begin inspection at the top-right corner of the matrix: coordinate (0, cols - 1).

hints.title: Directional Transition Invariant
hints.text: If the current cell is 1, move left to seek an earlier occurrence; if 0, move down to the next row.

hints.title: Complete Implementation

complexity.notes: Each step moves either down one row or left one column, performing at most R + C total API queries.
complexity.whyNaiveFails: Querying every cell or executing independent binary search per row uses O(R * log C) API queries, exceeding limits.
complexity.spaceTimeTradeoff: Staircase tracking uses constant extra space while minimizing API access count.
complexity.interviewerExpectation: Optimal O(R + C) staircase walk starting from top-right corner.
